sources.title: Foldit: Small molecule design / Tweak Ligand
sources.evidence: The source describes curved double-ended arrows attached to rotatable bonds, handles that can hide behind the ligand, and torsion changes used to improve bonding or Torsion Quality.

transformation: The benchmark turns that interaction pattern into an original deterministic articulated-key and translucent-pocket geometry task. It does not copy Foldit assets, molecular data, scoring, or an efficacy claim.
runtime_assets: All visible geometry is generated by the pocket_locksmith generator and rendered by the local browser mechanic; no third-party image or font asset is loaded.
